author: Muhammad Adnan
scope: Additional post hoc analyses requested in supplied revision; prior results already viewed; not an independent registration

M1.diversity: All45 unique RR/JJ/RJ pairs: Pearson scores, binary-error phi, decision disagreement, classwise and macro; primary cyclic blocks highlighted
M1.oracle: Unattainable per-record-per-class label-informed component selector: max for positives and min for negatives; an optimistic bound, never a model

M2.endpoints: Original unchanged component/blend NORM score>=.5 rates per source statement; AF and flutter explicit; no clinical relabeling

M3: Prepare cardiologist review materials only; no clinical signoff or coauthor invented
M4: Audit prior fold9/10 access first. Use existing exact-model held-out scores if available; otherwise separately lock descriptive inference with no retuning. Never describe historically viewed folds as fresh confirmation.

M5.invalid: No silent clipping: any factor*pi>=1 is invalid for that class and all-five macro; four-abnormal-target summary separately labelled
M5.evaluation: Original illustrative blend, fixed source prevalence and transported vector; alter assumed prevalence only, no fitted thresholds; prevalence estimate need not use per-record labels although this diagnostic uses empirical target prevalence

M6.leave_one_out: Omit each R or J seed separately; primary cyclic edges retained if both endpoints remain; all45 pair sensitivity separately

crossed.scheme: Resample5wholemodels/family with replacement and target patients with replacement in same draw; all10within-family and25cross-family positions; identical-fit duplicate edges have zero gain
crossed.interpretation: Finite-five-model exploratory resampling diagnostic, not reliable population-level seed inference

M7: One external site and one pretrained encoder; no second cohort/encoder added; narrower title and abstract scope
constraints: Preserve original models, mapping, eligibility and primary endpoints
No publication/ethics/clinical-review or human-verification claim without actual evidence
Keep all adverse endpoints; no best-seed or threshold selection
